purpose: Targeted Supplementary check of whether independent botanical orientation descriptions agree with image-derived taxon medians and the frozen orientation-BIO12 candidate direction.
targeted_candidate: larger image-referenced orientation angle with higher annual precipitation
interpretation: Independent literature state is directionally concordant with both the image-derived orientation median and BIO12 in this small pilot, but neither targeted comparison reaches conventional significance. This is therefore feasibility and external-consistency evidence, not confirmation of the v2 candidate.

excluded_or_non_strict_taxa.notes: Excluded from strict binary validation because source itself is equivocal.
Excluded from strict binary validation because orientation changes with developmental stage in the source account.

claim_boundary: The pilot does not change the primary full-27 atlas, multiplicity families, broad-space gate or final candidate set.
Species-level botanical descriptions are not independent individual-level gravity measurements.
A categorical literature state cannot validate continuous camera geometry or developmental-stage effects.
The pilot does not close the independent detector, reference-measurement, developmental-stage, colour-control or repeat-photo gates.
No additional traits or environmental predictors are screened.
